newsitem.title: USA: CBOT NOV SOYBEANS TURN LOWER ON COMMERCIAL SALES.
newsitem.headline: CBOT NOV SOYBEANS TURN LOWER ON COMMERCIAL SALES.

text.p: CBOT November soybeans turned lower after a higher start early Tuesday in response to commercial selling and prospects for a record 1997/98 (Sep/Aug) U.S. soybean crop, traders said.
"We're going to have a big bean crop, and these rains are going to help," one trader said.
The market began to weaken after Cargill sold one million bushels of November soybeans, floor traders said.
Also on Tuesday, USDA forecast a larger-than-expected soybean crop of 2.744 billion bushels. That number is up 15 percent from last year and above trade expectations for 2.607 to 2.731 billion.
